annotations.text:
What the DESIGN.md decided:

· one shadow, used twice — everything else is a 1px hairline
· 14px radius on photos, 8px on controls, full on the search bar
· 16px gutters in the grid against 32px between sections
· 48px buttons, 56px inputs

What it did not decide: the accent is Airbnb's own #ff385c, and Cereal is not licensable so Nunito Sans stands in.
